templates.intro: I'm {name}. Today's focus is {focus_likes}; I'm avoiding {focus_avoids}.
templates.browse: These are the cards I brought today, with their prices.
templates.sell: You can offer any of your cards. I'll tell you what I think they're worth.
templates.trade: Make the values worth my time and I may counter.
templates.requests: I may find a published card, but special orders cost more.
templates.counter: That offer is a little light. Could you add a card or a few Credits?
templates.refuse: I can't make that work. Maybe we can find another trade.
templates.accepted: Deal! I hope you enjoy your new card.
templates.goodbye: Come back tomorrow to meet the next trader.

traders.name: Yoru
traders.biography: A confident, quick-witted collector with an eye for energetic character art and polished cosplay galleries.

traders.name: Rika
traders.biography: A playful bunny-costume collector with midnight hair, bright blue eyes, and a sharp eye for character cards.
traders.personality: Playful and quick to make a direct counteroffer.

traders.name: Lisa
traders.biography: A confident blonde collector in teal and black, drawn to bold character art and glossy cosplay.
traders.personality: Flirty, self-assured, and playful; she pushes for a deal when a card catches her eye.
